title: Immune-Mediated Thrombocytopenia (ITP)
desc: Steroids, cyclosporine, doxycycline and vincristine for dogs; prednisolone, cyclosporine and chlorambucil for cats. Includes the full prednisone taper and the GI protection that goes with it.

meds.name: Prednisone
meds.note: 1 mg/kg BID to start. TAPER: 1 mg/kg BID daily for 3 weeks, then 0.5 mg/kg BID daily for 3 weeks, then 0.5 mg/kg SID daily for 3 weeks, then 0.5 mg/kg EVERY OTHER DAY for 3 months. Reduce by 25% every 2 to 3 weeks until every-other-day dosing is reached.

meds.name: Dexamethasone
meds.note: 0.2–0.5 mg/kg SID SQ or IV. Dex SP is 3 mg/ml and plain dexamethasone is 2 mg/ml — divide the milligrams by the concentration you have in hand.

meds.name: Vincristine
meds.note: 0.02 mg/kg IV. Using the 1 mg/ml solution, the millilitres equal the milligrams. Give through a clean, well-placed catheter — it is a severe vesicant if it extravasates.

meds.name: Doxycycline
meds.desc: covers tick-borne causes while the work-up runs

meds.name: Sucralfate
meds.desc: protects the stomach on high-dose steroids
meds.doseText: 0.5 to 1 g as a water slurry
meds.note: Give on an empty stomach, at least an hour away from other medication.

meds.name: Prednisolone
meds.desc: the backbone of treatment in cats
meds.note: Prednisolone, not prednisone, in cats. Taper by 25% every 2 to 3 weeks once the platelet count is stable.

meds.name: Dexamethasone
meds.note: 0.3–1 mg/kg SID. Dex SP is 3 mg/ml, plain dexamethasone 2 mg/ml.

meds.name: Chlorambucil
meds.note: Handle as a cytotoxic drug — gloves, no splitting of tablets.

meds.name: Vincristine
meds.note: 0.02 mg/kg IV. With the 1 mg/ml solution the millilitres equal the milligrams.

notes.Prednisone taper (dog): 1 mg/kg BID daily for 3 weeks → 0.5 mg/kg BID daily for 3 weeks → 0.5 mg/kg SID daily for 3 weeks → 0.5 mg/kg EVERY OTHER DAY for 3 months. Overall this is a 25% reduction every 2 to 3 weeks until every-other-day dosing is reached, then continue EOD for 3 months.
notes.Stabilise first: Stabilise the platelet numbers before starting to taper anything.
notes.Which drug to taper first: Taper the steroids first, unless cost makes that impractical.
notes.If it recurs: A long-term adjunctive immunosuppressant and/or splenectomy.
notes.Dexamethasone concentrations: Dex SP 3 mg/ml, plain dexamethasone 2 mg/ml. Check which is on the shelf before drawing up.
notes.GI protection: High-dose steroids in these patients warrant sucralfate, omeprazole and an anti-emetic alongside.

dischargeBlocks.title: What ITP is
dischargeBlocks.text:
Platelets are the cells that make blood clot. {name}'s immune system has started destroying them, so bruising and bleeding happen very easily.

The medication switches that immune attack off. It works, but it takes time, and the doses have to come down slowly — not stop suddenly.

dischargeBlocks.title: Call us immediately if you see
dischargeBlocks.text:
- Fresh bruising, or pinpoint red spots on the gums, belly or ears
- Blood in the urine or stool, or black tarry stools
- Nosebleeds
- Pale gums, weakness, or collapse
- Any bleeding that does not stop

These mean the platelet count may have fallen again and need to be seen the same day.

dischargeBlocks.title: Keeping {name} safe while platelets are low
dischargeBlocks.text:
- No rough play, jumping from furniture, or off-lead running.
- Lead walks only, on soft ground.
- No hard chews or bones.
- Avoid injections, nail trims and dental work unless we have advised them.

A knock that would not normally matter can cause serious bleeding right now.

dischargeBlocks.title: What the steroids will do
dischargeBlocks.text:
{name} will drink and urinate much more, be very hungry, and may pant more. This is expected and is not a reason to stop.

- Always leave water available.
- Accidents in the house are likely at first — please be patient.
- Do NOT stop the steroid suddenly or skip doses. Stopping abruptly is dangerous.

We reduce the dose in steps over several months. Follow the schedule on the label exactly, and call us before making any change.

dischargeBlocks.title: Stomach protection
dischargeBlocks.text:
High-dose steroids irritate the stomach, so we have sent medication to protect it.

If we dispensed sucralfate, give it on an empty stomach and keep it at least an hour away from every other medication — it will bind the other drugs otherwise.

dischargeBlocks.title: Follow up
dischargeBlocks.text:
We need to recheck {name}'s platelet count on the schedule we discussed — frequently at first, then less often as things stabilise.

These appointments decide when the dose comes down, so please keep every one of them even when {name} looks well.
